description: Turn any REST/OpenAPI, SOAP/WSDL, GraphQL or SQL API into MCP tools for Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot, no code. 259 pre-built adapters for ERP and e-commerce (SAP Business One, Odoo, Xentral, JTL-Wawi, weclapp, Shopware, WooCommerce, Amazon Seller, Kaufland, OTTO…) and more. Self-hosted, knowledge graph, per-tool response mapping, OAuth2/RBAC/SSO/audit. Open source under AGPL-3.0.
